facts.text: NewU University offers a direct 3-year, 120-credit bachelor's degree in Washington, DC with no summer or weekend classes, operating on a four-day schedule from Monday to Thursday.

sources.title: NewU University - Home of the 3-Year Bachelor's Degree
sources.quote: NewU is the first 3-year, 120-credit bachelor's degree college in the US. We offer shorter, affordable, career-ready majors.
